_meta.architecture: XGBoost (per-condition tuned hyperparameters, early stopping on val)
_meta.note: Sepsis uses PhysioNet-adjudicated labels. ARF/Cardiac/AKI/Coagulopathy use rule-based clinical proxy labels — not adjudicated ground truth. All models (incl. XGBoost) see the same 24h window of context as the LSTM (single-hour + 24h window-summary features).
